Naina Gupta
Backend Engineer | Andheri East, Mumbai
naina.gupta565@example.com | +91 9447961723

Backend-focused engineer with strong experience building scalable APIs and data pipelines using Python. Comfortable designing reliable services, optimizing database interactions, and deploying containerized applications in cloud environments. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 90 days.

Experience
UrbanPantry, Mar 2024 - Present
Backend Engineer — Remote
- Implemented new order-management API endpoints using Django and FastAPI, reducing average order processing latency by 35% and supporting a 2x increase in peak throughput.
- Containerized services with Docker and introduced CI pipelines to build and deploy backend images, cutting deployment time from 45 minutes to under 10 minutes.
- Designed PostgreSQL schema changes and optimized queries, lowering median checkout transaction time by 28% and reducing lock contention during peak hours.
- Built background job workflows with Celery and Redis for retryable tasks (payments, inventory sync), improving failure recovery and reducing manual intervention by 60%.

Kite Learning, Sep 2023 - Feb 2024
Python Developer — Hybrid
- Developed FastAPI microservices to handle event ingestion and transformation, processing 150k+ events/day and ensuring end-to-end latency under 1s for 90% of requests.
- Integrated Apache Kafka for real-time event streaming between services and implemented consumer groups for scalable processing, enabling smooth horizontal scaling during spikes.
- Migrated key data stores to AWS-managed PostgreSQL and configured automated backups and failover, improving recovery RPO/RTO and simplifying operations.
- Wrote Django-based admin tools for content management and analytics exports, increasing content update velocity and enabling weekly reporting automation.

Projects
- Real-time Order Monitor: Built a lightweight FastAPI service that subscribes to Kafka topics to aggregate order metrics and push alerts via webhook; reduced incident detection time by 40% during testing.
- Local Dev Containerization: Created Docker compose setups for local development with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery, cutting onboarding time for new engineers from days to hours.
